name: Secure text stats webhook
description: POST {"text": "..."} with an X-Webhook-Token header to http://127.0.0.1:5678/webhook/text-stats and get word and character counts back. Needs a 'webhook-token' credential with a 'token' field.

body.text: Automation Studio runs automations on your own Windows PC.

parameters.code:
import re
from collections import Counter

def main(input):
    text = str((input.get('body') or {}).get('text', ''))
    words = re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', text.lower())
    top = Counter(w for w in words if len(w) > 3).most_common(3)
    return {'characters': len(text), 'words': len(words), 'top_words': [w for w, _ in top]}
